WEEKEND

The purpose

A proper guys’ weekend, built around padel.

Eight close friends leave Atlanta on Thursday, October 29 and return Sunday, November 1—three nights of competitive padel, memorable dinners and just enough downtime to make it feel like a real escape.

Editor’s choice

Costa Rica

Panama wins on absolute price. Costa Rica wins the weekend: nonstop Delta, a resort-style Marriott, strong courts and the advantage of Alvaro’s local knowledge.

DatesThu–SunOct. 29–Nov. 1

Top recommendation

San José, Costa Rica

01
The hotel

Costa Rica Marriott Hotel Hacienda Belén

$1,242 pp
Single occupancy · $936 pp double occupancy

$204 per night for a two-bed room. Three-night room total: $612.

Resort atmosphere near SJO, with outdoor pools, Kuö Spa, multiple restaurants, a fitness center and a golf practice range.

Alvaro: Please suggest any private clubs, favorite restaurants, driver options or local experiences that beat the public choices below.

Best dining + nightlife

Mexico City

The hotel

Sheraton Maria Isabel Reforma

$1,881 pp
Single occupancy · $1,541 pp double occupancy

$227 per night corporate rate. Three-night room total: $681.

Familiar ground: this is where the group stayed during the Formula One trip, so the location and neighborhood already feel known.

Return-table candidate: Máximo Bistrot was a group favorite on that trip and belongs near the top of the dinner list.
